message:
The yen receipt test passes now. `npm test` runs 18 tests, all passing.

**Cause:** `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js` always divides by 100 and prints two decimals. So a ¥500 receipt came out as "¥5.00". Yen has no minor unit, so the amount is already whole yen.

**Fix:** I changed only `src/payments/receipt.js`. Yen amounts are now printed as whole numbers, and every other currency still goes through `formatMoney`. This is the only file changed, and nothing is committed.

**Outside scope, not changed:** `src/utils/money.js` has the same bug for any JPY amount. Invoices, cart totals and admin reports that call `formatMoney` with JPY will still show wrong values. The proper fix belongs in that file, so the owning team should handle it.
